_about: Each breast shape as multipliers on the fat of breast_L and breast_R (by eye, edit to change). The divided zones are left and right only, so a shape here sets how much the breast holds and how much deep gland it has, not its outline. Adjustments: espacados (0 to 1) thins the fat between the breasts, in the chest zone; pendentes (0 to 1) softens the skin over them, as the fraction that comes off the skin's stiffness; assimetricos is a multiplier per side.
